'''Fabrin''' was an underground [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thorgeld I]]. It was the site of the [[Mandel family mansion|mansion]] of the [[Mandel family]] who ruled [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]].
